# Combine Biomass, Mass and Abundance into one plot with three different colours

```{r}
biomass_eff <- biomass_eff %>% mutate("Response variable" = "Total biomass")
avgmass_eff <- avgmass_eff %>% mutate("Response variable" = "Average mass")
abundance_eff <- abundance_eff %>% mutate("Response variable" = "Species abundance")


combined <- rbind(biomass_eff, avgmass_eff, abundance_eff)


p <- combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Predominant_land_use,
             y = Percent_diff,
             colour = Variable,
             group = Variable)) +
  
  # zero line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  # confidence intervals for each Variable
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Percent_lower,
                     ymax = Percent_upper),
                 linewidth = 1,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  
  # points for each Variable
  geom_point(size = 3,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  
  # manual colours
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Total biomass" = "purple",
    "Average live mass" = "blue",
    "Species abundance" = "red"
  )) +
  
  # aesthetics & theme
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 6.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5, linetype = 2) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  xlab("Land use intensity class") +
  ylab("Difference in log response variable (%)") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes=list(shape = 16, size = 6, linetype = 0))) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) 


 #ggsave(filename = "./figures/C3_updated_figures/combined-LU-plot.png",  plot = p, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Combine all three LUI plots for biomass, mass and abundance. Stack them above one another with the x labels only appearing once

```{r}
library(patchwork)

p1 <- AbundanceLUIPlot + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12), axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12))
p2 <- MassLUIPlot + theme(axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 12), axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12))
p3 <- BiomassLUIPlot + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12), axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12))

final_plot <- (p1 / p2 / p3) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Now blank FIRST TWO x axes again (after global theme):
final_plot[[1]] <- final_plot[[1]] + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                           axis.title.x = element_blank())
final_plot[[2]] <- final_plot[[2]] + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                           axis.title.x = element_blank())

  #ggsave(filename = "./figures/C3_updated_figures/combined-LUI-plot.png",  plot = final_plot, width = 18, height = 10, dpi = 300)

rm(p1, p2, p3, MassLUIPlot, AbundanceLUIPlot, BiomassLUIPlot, final_plot)
```

# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS

# Figure which removes studies with < 10% unique size values across taxa within a site for LU

```{r}
# Pull studies with less than 10 percent unique size values among taxa sampled at a site
lessthan10 <- FilteredUniqueSiteMassValues %>%
  filter(percent_unique < 10) %>%
  pull(SS) %>% 
  unique()

# Create the model data by filtering out those studies
model10 <- model_data_avg_mass %>%
  filter(!SS %in% lessthan10)

# LU model with reduced studies
reduced_model <- lmer(LogAvgSiteBiomass ~ Predominant_land_use + (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SS) + (1 | SSB), 
           data = model10)

# model estimates
summary(reduced_model)
anova(reduced_model)
model_plot(reduced_model)


# gather the effects and confidence intervals using simulation. Simulate 1000 times
eff <- FEsim(reduced_model, n.sims = 1000)

  # make the term column a factor so it can be recoded
  eff$term <- as.factor(eff$term)
  
  # rename factors for ease of visualisation
  eff$term <- recode_factor(eff$term, "(Intercept)" = "Primary",
                                "Predominant_land_useYoung secondary vegetation" = "YSV",
                                "Predominant_land_useIntermediate secondary vegetation" = "ISV",
                                "Predominant_land_useMature secondary vegetation" = "MSV",
                                "Predominant_land_useSecondary vegetation" = "Secondary vegetation",
                                "Predominant_land_usePlantation forest" = "Plantation",
                                "Predominant_land_usePasture" = "Pasture",
                                "Predominant_land_useCropland" = "Cropland",
                                "Predominant_land_useUrban" = "Urban")
  
  # Add in upper and lower confidence intervals 
  eff <- eff %>%
    mutate(Upper_ci = (median + 1.96*sd)) %>%
    mutate(Lower_ci = (median - 1.96*sd))
  
  
    eff <- eff %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_diff = (((exp(median[1] + median) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1))*100)-100) %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_upper = (((exp(median[1] + Upper_ci) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1)) * 100) - 100) %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_lower = (((exp(median[1] + Lower_ci) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1)) * 100) - 100)
  
      eff[1,7] <- 0 #shift median
      eff[1,8] <- 0 #shift upper
      eff[1,9] <- 0 #shift lower
      
      colnames(eff)[1] <- "Predominant_land_use"
      
     p <- eff %>%
        ggplot()+
        aes(x = Predominant_land_use, y = Percent_diff)+
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = ("black"), linetype = 1)+
        geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5))+
        geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Percent_lower, ymax = Percent_upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), linewidth = 1)+
        theme_classic()+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = 2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = 2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = 2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 4.5, linetype = 2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 5.5, linetype = 2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 6.5, linetype = 2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5, linetype = 2)+
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face= "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
              axis.title.x = element_blank(),
              axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
              panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black",  fill=NA))+
        xlab("Land use intensity class")+
        ylab("log(average mass) difference (%)") +
        guides(color = guide_legend(
          override.aes=list(shape = 15, size = 10)))
     
  #ggsave(filename = "../figures/avg_mass_LU_10percent.png",  plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

mass_sensitivity_eff <- eff %>% mutate(Analysis = "Sensitivity analysis")
  
rm(eff, reduced_model, model10, lessthan10, p)     

```

# Combine coefficients from non-sensitivity and sensitivity analysis of mass (LU)

```{r}
avgmass_eff <- avgmass_eff %>% mutate(Data = "All of the data")
mass_sensitivity_eff <- mass_sensitivity_eff %>% mutate(Data = "Studies with homogenous size data excluded")

combined <- rbind(mass_sensitivity_eff, avgmass_eff)

p <- combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Predominant_land_use,
             y = Percent_diff,
             colour = Data,
             group = Data)) +
  
  # zero line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  # confidence intervals for each Variable
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Percent_lower,
                     ymax = Percent_upper),
                 linewidth = 1,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  
  # points for each Variable
  geom_point(size = 3,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  
  # manual colours
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "All of the data" = "black",
    "Studies with homogenous size data excluded" = "red"
  )) +
  
  # aesthetics & theme
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = 2) +
```

# Start with biomass ~ LU * Order analysis

```{r}
# Create a separate data frame
orders_size <- all_insects_size_updated 

# Lets look at the number of sites per order
orders_size %>%
  group_by(Order) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(count))

# Orders to keep and assign all others to "other_orders"
target_orders <- c("Hymenoptera", "Lepidoptera", "Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera")

orders_size <- orders_size %>%
  mutate(Order = case_when(
    Order %in% target_orders ~ Order,
    TRUE ~ "Other_orders"
  ))

unique(orders_size$Order)
```

# (NEW CODE) the big five orders - up to five size values per site

```{r}
# Calculate the biomass of each taxa
orders_size <- orders_size %>% 
  mutate(
    Biomass = mass_mg * Merged_diversity
  )

# there are 34 studies where all sites have zero total biomass, so min(TotalSiteBiomass[TotalSiteBiomass > 0]) has no values to take the minimum of and returns Inf
# Inspecting these studies reveals that none of the rows/taxa/sites have a body length value.
# I will remove rows with no body length value
orders_size <- orders_size %>%
  filter(!is.na(mass_mg_match_level))

orders_size <- orders_size %>%
  group_by(SSBS, Order) %>% # Calculate for each site x order combination
  mutate(TotalSiteOrderBiomass = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # Calculate total site biomass for each order 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SS) %>% # Now group by study
  mutate(
    SmallestNonZeroTotalSiteOrderBiomass = min(TotalSiteOrderBiomass[TotalSiteOrderBiomass > 0]), # Which site x order combo has the smallest total biomass greater than 0 per study? 
    Log_plus_what = ifelse(
    Diversity_metric_unit %in% c("individuals", "times observed"), min(mass_mg, na.rm = TRUE),  
    # If abundance data are counts, assign the smallest mass_mg for an individual of any species in the study
    SmallestNonZeroTotalSiteOrderBiomass / 2)) %>%  # else 1/2 the SmallestNonZeroTotalSiteOrderBiomass for any site within the study 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SSBS, Order) %>%  # Calculate for each site x order combination
  mutate(LogBiomass = log(TotalSiteOrderBiomass + Log_plus_what)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Calculate one LogBiomass value per site x order combination
LogBiomass_summary <- orders_size %>%
  group_by(SSBS, Order) %>%
  summarise(
    n_TSOB = n_distinct(TotalSiteOrderBiomass), 
    n_LPW = n_distinct(Log_plus_what),
    is_consistent = (n_TSOB == 1 & n_LPW == 1), # sense check that all TotalSiteOrderBiomass and Log_plus_what values are the same for all rows in the site x order combination
    TotalSiteBiomass = first(TotalSiteOrderBiomass),
    Log_plus_what = first(Log_plus_what),
    LogBiomass = log(first(TotalSiteBiomass) + first(Log_plus_what)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# All sites are consistent
LogBiomass_summary %>% filter(is_consistent != TRUE)

inconsistent_groups <- orders_size %>%
  group_by(SSBS, Order) %>%
  summarise(
    n_TSB = n_distinct(TotalSiteOrderBiomass),
    n_LPW = n_distinct(Log_plus_what)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_TSB > 1 | n_LPW > 1) 

# No rows where LogBiomass is 0, NA, or blank
LogBiomass_summary %>%
  filter(is.na(LogBiomass) | LogBiomass == 0 | LogBiomass == "") %>% View()

rm(inconsistent_groups)
```

# Merge with PREDICTS but this time keep a row for each order within each site!
```{r}
# Create the other orders column so we filter for the correct number of sites
insects <- insects %>%
  mutate(Order = case_when(
    Order %in% target_orders ~ Order,
    TRUE ~ "Other_orders"
  ))

# Use distinct() to keep only the first appearance of each Order within each site
ssbs_by_order <- insects %>%
  distinct(SSBS, Order, .keep_all = TRUE) # 23,381 sites!

# merge LogBiomass_summary values
BiomassByOrder <- ssbs_by_order %>%
  left_join(LogBiomass_summary, by = c("SSBS", "Order")) %>% 
  droplevels()

# Have a look at sites with no LogBiomass
no_biomass <- BiomassByOrder %>%
  filter(
    is.na(LogBiomass) |         # remove NA
    is.nan(LogBiomass)|        # remove NaN
    LogBiomass == ""            # remove empty strings
  )  # I think this is because these rows do not have a body size value, therefore no LogBiomass value. 

all_insects_size_updated %>% filter(SS == "AC1_2022__Kinneen 1") %>% View()

# filter out sites with no LogBiomass
BiomassByOrder <- BiomassByOrder %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(LogBiomass),         # remove NA
    !is.nan(LogBiomass),        # remove NaN
    LogBiomass != ""            # remove empty strings
  )

sum(!is.na(LogBiomass_summary$LogBiomass)) # number of site x order combos with data, sensitivity check as should match number of sites in BiomassByOrder 

rm(ssbs_by_order, no_biomass, LogBiomass_summary, orders_size)
```

# Prep model data
```{r}
# Create model data
big_five <- BiomassByOrder 

# Lets look at the number of sites per order
big_five %>%
  group_by(Order) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(count)) %>% 
  View()

# Rename predominant habitat since its not really habitat we're looking at
big_five <- rename(big_five,
                Predominant_land_use = Predominant_habitat)

# Relevel the land use and use intensity classes
big_five <- big_five %>%
  mutate(
    # collapse primary forest and non-forest together into primary vegetation as these aren't well distinguished
    Predominant_land_use = recode_factor(Predominant_land_use, 
                                         "Primary forest" = "Primary", 
                                         "Primary non-forest" = "Primary"),
    # indeterminate secondary veg and cannot decide get NA
   #Predominant_land_use = na_if(Predominant_land_use, "Secondary vegetation (indeterminate age)"),
    Predominant_land_use = na_if(Predominant_land_use, "Cannot decide"), 
    Use_intensity = na_if(Use_intensity, "Cannot decide"),
   
       # collapse secondary age categories into one and include SV (indeterminate age)
    Predominant_land_use = recode_factor(Predominant_land_use, 
                                         "Young secondary vegetation" = "Secondary vegetation", 
                                         "Intermediate secondary vegetation" = "Secondary vegetation",
                                         "Mature secondary vegetation" = "Secondary vegetation",
                                         "Secondary vegetation (indeterminate age)" = "Secondary vegetation"),
    
    # set reference levels
    Predominant_land_use = factor(Predominant_land_use),
    Predominant_land_use = relevel(Predominant_land_use, ref = "Primary"),
    Use_intensity = factor(Use_intensity),
    Use_intensity = relevel(Use_intensity, ref = "Minimal use")
  )

table(big_five$Order, big_five$Predominant_land_use)

```

# Modelling biomass ~ LU * Order

```{r}
# Set order as a factor variable for modelling
big_five <- big_five %>%
  mutate(Order = as.factor(Order))

# maximal model
m1 <- lmer(LogBiomass ~ Predominant_land_use * Order + (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SS) + (1 | SSB), 
           data = big_five)

# remove block
m2 <-lmer(LogBiomass ~ Predominant_land_use * Order + (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SS),
    data = big_five)

# remove study
m3 <-lmer(LogBiomass ~ Predominant_land_use + (1 | Source_ID),
    data = big_five)

AIC(m1, m2, m3) # m1 best model

# model estimates
summary(m1)
anova(m1)
model_plot(m1)

rm(m2, m3)
```

# Coleoptera effects
```{r}
# gather the effects and confidence intervals using simulation. Simulate 1000 times
col_eff <- FEsim(m1, n.sims = 1000)

  # make the term column a factor so it can be recoded
  col_eff$term <- as.factor(col_eff$term)
  
   # pull out effects
  col_eff <- col_eff %>%
    slice(1:6) 
  
  # rename factors for ease of visualisation
  col_eff$term <- recode_factor(col_eff$term, "(Intercept)" = "Primary",
                                #"Predominant_land_useYoung secondary vegetation" = "YSV",
                                #"Predominant_land_useIntermediate secondary vegetation" = "ISV",
                                #"Predominant_land_useMature secondary vegetation" = "MSV",
                                "Predominant_land_useSecondary vegetation" = "Secondary vegetation",
                                "Predominant_land_usePlantation forest" = "Plantation",
                                "Predominant_land_usePasture" = "Pasture",
                                "Predominant_land_useCropland" = "Cropland",
                                "Predominant_land_useUrban" = "Urban")
  
  # Add in upper and lower confidence intervals 
  col_eff <- col_eff %>%
    mutate(Upper_ci = (median + 1.96*sd)) %>%
    mutate(Lower_ci = (median - 1.96*sd))
  
  
    col_eff <- col_eff %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_diff = (((exp(median[1] + median) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1))*100)-100) %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_upper = (((exp(median[1] + Upper_ci) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1)) * 100) - 100) %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_lower = (((exp(median[1] + Lower_ci) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1)) * 100) - 100)
  
      col_eff[1,7] <- 0 #shift median
      col_eff[1,8] <- 0 #shift upper
      col_eff[1,9] <- 0 #shift lower
      
      colnames(col_eff)[1] <- "Predominant_land_use"
      
  # Add in a column of Order to make sure there is a grouping variable
   col_eff <- col_eff %>% mutate(Order = "Coleoptera")

  # make the order column a factor so it can be recoded
   col_eff$Order <- as.factor(col_eff$Order)      
      
rm(m1)
```

```{r}
other_ref <- within(big_five, Order <- relevel(Order, ref = "Other_orders"))

# other_orders model
other_m <- lmer(LogBiomass ~ Predominant_land_use * Order + (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SS) + (1 | SSB), 
           data = other_ref)

summary(other_m) 

# gather the effects and confidence intervals using simulation. Simulate 1000 times
other_eff <- FEsim(other_m, n.sims = 1000)

  # make the term column a factor so it can be recoded
  other_eff$term <- as.factor(other_eff$term)
  
   # pull out effects
  other_eff <- other_eff %>%
    slice(1:6) 
  
  # rename factors for ease of visualisation
  other_eff$term <- recode_factor(other_eff$term, "(Intercept)" = "Primary",
                                #"Predominant_land_useYoung secondary vegetation" = "YSV",
                                #"Predominant_land_useIntermediate secondary vegetation" = "ISV",
                                #"Predominant_land_useMature secondary vegetation" = "MSV",
                                "Predominant_land_useSecondary vegetation" = "Secondary vegetation",
                                "Predominant_land_usePlantation forest" = "Plantation",
                                "Predominant_land_usePasture" = "Pasture",
                                "Predominant_land_useCropland" = "Cropland",
                                "Predominant_land_useUrban" = "Urban")
  
  # Add in upper and lower confidence intervals 
  other_eff <- other_eff %>%
    mutate(Upper_ci = (median + 1.96*sd)) %>%
    mutate(Lower_ci = (median - 1.96*sd))
  
  
    other_eff <- other_eff %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_diff = (((exp(median[1] + median) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1))*100)-100) %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_upper = (((exp(median[1] + Upper_ci) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1)) * 100) - 100) %>%
        mutate(
          Percent_lower = (((exp(median[1] + Lower_ci) - 1) / (exp(median[1]) - 1)) * 100) - 100)
  
      other_eff[1,7] <- 0 #shift median
      other_eff[1,8] <- 0 #shift upper
      other_eff[1,9] <- 0 #shift lower
      
      colnames(other_eff)[1] <- "Predominant_land_use"
      
  # Add in a column of Order to make sure there is a grouping variable
   other_eff <- other_eff %>% mutate(Order = "Other_orders")

  # make the order column a factor so it can be recoded
   other_eff$Order <- as.factor(other_eff$Order)     
      
rm(other_ref, other_m)
```

# Combine the effects and plot them
```{r}
combined <- rbind(col_eff, dip_eff, hemi_eff, hym_eff, lep_eff, other_eff)

# Add land-use factors for plotting
comb_plot_limits <- c("Primary", "Secondary vegetation", "Plantation", "Pasture", "Cropland", "Urban") 

# Add specific colours for each order
group_colours <- c(
  "#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3",
  "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02"
)

# Remove rows for plantation for Leps and other_orders which have crazy CIs
combined <- combined[-c(27,33),]

  p <- combined %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = Predominant_land_use, y = Percent_diff, colour = Order, group = Order) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Percent_lower, ymax = Percent_upper),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = comb_plot_limits) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5), linetype = 2) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face= "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom"        # 👈 Move legend
  ) +
  xlab("Land use intensity class") +
  ylab("log(biomass) difference (%)") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colours) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 19, size = 3))) +  # 👈 round icons
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = group_colours,
  labels = c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Hymenoptera",
             "Lepidoptera", "Other orders") # Change Other_orders to Other orders
) +
theme(
  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-100, 150, by = 25))
 
        
#ggsave(filename = "./figures/C3_updated_figures/big_five_LU_second.png",  plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

rm(col_eff, dip_eff, hemi_eff, hym_eff, lep_eff, p, other_eff)
```
